_comment: The Predge v2 set (contracts/v2). Same rules as set.json: contract i is created at deployer nonce i, so a fresh v2 deployer + this order gives the same addresses on every chain. Never reorder; append only. $owner is the Safe, $operator the hot ops key, $deployer holds NO role (it only pays gas). Chain-specific values (minBond, arbiterMinBond) come from config/v2.chains.json and do not change the addresses. Owner decision 20.10.2026: bonds MINIMAL, bondBps = arbiterBondBps = 0, so every bond is exactly the per-chain floor (~$5); the bps mechanism stays in the contracts and the Safe can raise it later with setParams (a paid bonded-verdict tier).

plan.name: PredgeAgentValidatorV2
plan.role: ERC-8004 validation registry, request-before-response, domain-separated request hashes

plan.name: AgentJobV2
plan.role: ERC-8183-style job escrow with expiry and pull payments; no owner

plan.name: PredgeValidatorBondV2
plan.role: commit-reveal validator bond; the evaluator of AgentJobV2

plan.name: PredgeSettlementV2
plan.role: pay-per-route receipts in the native token

plan.name: MockRefundProtocolV2
plan.role: DEMO ONLY stand-in Refund Protocol (moves no money); out of audit scope

plan.name: PredgeRefundArbiterV2
plan.role: optimistic bonded refund arbiter; Safe is the court of last resort
